description_en: Queries logs in a project. You can use this operation to query logs at the project level
description_zh: 查询目标Project下的日志，该接口是Project级别的SQL查询接口
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-project-logs --project ali-test-project --query SELECT_COUNT_0_as_pv_FROM_nginx-moni_where_time_1646102500_and_time_1646103400 --power-sql false --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetProjectLogs

parameters.description_en: The standard SQL statement. In this example, the SQL statement queries the number of page views (PVs) from 2022-03-01 10:41:40 to 2022-03-01 10:56:40 in a Logstore whose name is nginx-moni.
parameters.description_zh: 标准SQL语句。例如日志库名称为nginx-moni，查询时间区间在2022-03-01 10:41:40到2022-03-01 10:56:40之间的访问数量。
parameters.example: SELECT COUNT(*) as pv FROM nginx-moni where __time__ > 1646102500 and __time__ < 1646103400
parameters.help_en: The standard SQL statement. In this example, the SQL statement queries the number of page views (PVs) from 2022-03-01 10:41:40 to 2022-03-01 10:56:40 in a Logstore whose name is nginx-moni
parameters.help_zh: 标准SQL语句。例如日志库名称为nginx-moni，查询时间区间在2022-03-01 10:41:40到2022-03-01 10:56:40之间的访问数量
